notes: Japan-market pages (nintendo.co.jp), model KTR-001; 'Newニンテンドー3DS' in Japan. Dimensions, mass and both displays were read from the dedicated New 3DS page AND independently confirmed on Nintendo's 本体の主な仕様 comparison page (https://www.nintendo.co.jp/hardware/3dsseries/specs/index.html), which gives identical figures; the KTR-004 stylus and KTR-003 battery listed in that column confirm the model identity. Axis mapping: Nintendo lists 縦80.6mm×横142mm×厚さ21.6mm; height=横142 (long axis), width=縦80.6, depth=厚さ21.6 — Nintendo's own label for the long axis is 'width' (横). Note Nintendo typesets 142ｍｍ with a full-width ｍｍ on this page; value is 142 mm. Closed/folded state (折りたたみ時), also the source for hinge.type=clamshell; open state not published. TOP SCREEN / AUTOSTEREOSCOPIC 3D: recorded literally as 横800ドット×縦240ドット = [800,240], aspect 10:3, with Nintendo's own same-line gloss that the 800 horizontal dots are split 400 per eye (per-eye 400x240, 5:3). This model's panel adds 3Dブレ防止機能 (face-tracking 3D stabilisation) per Nintendo's wording. ACTIVE AREA IS PUBLISHED, NOT DERIVED: Nintendo prints the mm active area inline with each diagonal, so 'derived' is deliberately FALSE — quoted, not computed. CONTROLS: this generation adds ZL/ZR shoulder buttons and the Cスティック, so bumper count 4 (L/R/ZL/ZR) and stick count 2 (slide pad + C-stick); counts follow Nintendo's enumerated list. controls[].position null — placement not stated; HOME and power buttons are listed under その他入力 with no matching enum kind, and the 3D depth slider is absent on this model. ports: microSD slot recorded (Nintendo explicitly states microSDカードスロット, unlike the full-size SD of earlier models); game card slot, charging terminal and AC adapter connector omitted (no matching enum kind); Nintendo does not state the headphone jack's 3.5 mm diameter. released = Japan launch; Western launch (2015) not sourced from a Nintendo page. announced: not sourced, null.
